operations.before:
macro_invocation: ($) =>
      prec(
        PRECS.call,
        prec.dynamic(
          DYNAMIC_PRECS.call,
          seq(
            $._hash_symbol,
            $.simple_identifier,
            optional($.type_parameters),
            $.call_suffix
          )
        )
      ),
operations.after:
macro_invocation: ($) =>
      prec.right(
        PRECS.call,
        prec.dynamic(
          DYNAMIC_PRECS.call,
          seq(
            $._hash_symbol,
            $.simple_identifier,
            optional($.type_arguments),
            optional($.call_suffix)
          )
        )
      ),

$.catch_keyword,
        optional(
          sep1(
            seq(
              field("error", alias($._binding_pattern_no_expr, $.pattern)),
              optional($.where_clause)
            ),
            ","
          )
        ),
        $._block

opaque_type: ($) => prec.right(-2, seq("some", $._opaque_operand)),
    existential_type: ($) => prec.right(-2, seq("any", $._opaque_operand)),
    _opaque_operand: ($) =>
      choice(
        $.user_type,
        $.tuple_type,
        $.array_type,
        $.inline_array_type,
        $.dictionary_type,
        alias($._opaque_metatype, $.metatype),
        $.bracket_qualified_type,
        $.protocol_composition_type,
        $.suppressed_constraint
      ),
    _opaque_metatype: ($) =>
      prec.dynamic(
        1,
        seq(
          choice($.user_type, $.tuple_type, $.array_type, $.dictionary_type),
          $._dot,
          choice("Type", "Protocol")
        )
      ),
    _opaque_optional_type: ($) =>
      prec.left(
        seq(
          field(
            "wrapped",
            choice(
              $.opaque_type,
              $.existential_type,
              alias($._opaque_optional_type, $.optional_type)
            )
          ),
          alias($._immediate_quest, "?")
        )
      ),

value_arguments: ($) =>
      seq(
        choice(
          seq(
            "(",
            optional(
              choice(
                alias($._reference_specifier_argument, $.value_argument),
                sep1Opt($.value_argument, ",")
              )
            ),
            ")"
          ),

computed_modify: ($) =>
      seq(repeat($.attribute), $.modify_specifier, optional($._block)),
    computed_borrow: ($) =>
      prec.dynamic(
        10,
        seq(
          repeat($.attribute),
          optional($.mutation_modifier),
          "borrow",
          optional($._block)
        )
      ),
    computed_mutate: ($) =>
      prec.dynamic(
        10,
        seq(
          repeat($.attribute),
          optional($.mutation_modifier),
          "mutate",
          optional($._block)
        )
      ),

_navigable_type_expression: ($) =>
      choice(
        $.user_type,
        $.array_type,
        $.dictionary_type,
        prec.dynamic(2, alias($._specialized_user_type, $.user_type))
      ),
    _specialized_user_type: ($) =>
      prec.right(
        PRECS.ty,
        seq(
          optional($.module_selector),
          repeat(seq($._simple_user_type, $._dot)),
          alias($.simple_identifier, $.type_identifier),
          $.type_arguments
        )
      ),

operations.before:
optional($.user_type), // XXX this should just be _type but that creates ambiguity
        $._dot,
        $.simple_identifier,
operations.after:
optional($.user_type), // XXX this should just be _type but that creates ambiguity
        $._dot,
        optional($.module_selector),
        $.simple_identifier,

$.bracket_qualified_type,
        alias($._opaque_composition, $.protocol_composition_type),
        $.suppressed_constraint
      ),
    _opaque_composition: ($) =>
      prec.left(seq($._opaque_element, repeat1(seq("&", $._opaque_element)))),
    _opaque_element: ($) =>
      prec(
        1,
        choice(
          $.user_type,
          $.tuple_type,
          $.array_type,
          $.inline_array_type,
          $.dictionary_type,
          alias($._opaque_metatype, $.metatype),
          $.bracket_qualified_type,
          $.suppressed_constraint
        )
      ),

prec.right(
          PRECS.control_transfer,
          seq(
            choice("return", "yield"),
            field("result", optional($._expression))
          )
        ),
        prec.right(
          PRECS.control_transfer,
          seq(
            choice("continue", "break"),
            field("result", optional($.simple_identifier))
          )
        )

operations.before:
bool possible_custom_operator = valid_symbols[CUSTOM_OPERATOR] &&

operations.after:
bool possible_custom_operator = (valid_symbols[CUSTOM_OPERATOR] || valid_symbols[POSTFIX_CUSTOM_OPERATOR]) &&
